purpose: Blueprint for the vendor GitHub App used by optional ANPOS commercial distribution. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
security_requirements: Generate the App private key only in GitHub and store it in an approved secret manager; never commit it.
Use the lowest permission set that supports the enabled delivery mode.
Do not enable collaborator administration unless collaborator provisioning is explicitly enabled.
Verify webhook signatures before processing payloads.
Reconcile ambiguous or missed Marketplace state through GitHub APIs.
Store final App/installation/repository identifiers only in deployed vendor runtime configuration.
